message: Bump the toroidal field on shot 30166 up by 10% — what does that do to confinement?

deltas: Let me put that past the gate.

deltas: I can't propose that edit: the archive has 3 matched pairs for toroidal-field edits, too few to test any response law — the gate refuses it rather than guessing, so I won't retry it or substitute a guess. Density, beam power and beam timing edits are testable on this shot if you want a what-if I can stand behind. Remember the twin is compared with MAST data, never a prediction.
